WITH recent_orders AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS purchase_ts,
    c.customer_unique_id AS custuniq
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c
    ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= date_trunc('month', current_date) - INTERVAL '11 months'
    AND CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < date_trunc('month', current_date) + INTERVAL '1 month'
),
top3 AS (
  SELECT
    custuniq
  FROM recent_orders
  GROUP BY custuniq
  ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
  LIMIT 3
),
months AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(date_trunc('month', gen_ts) AS DATE) AS month_start
  FROM generate_series(
    date_trunc('month', current_date) - INTERVAL '11 months',
    date_trunc('month', current_date),
    INTERVAL '1 month'
  ) AS gs(gen_ts)
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(date_trunc('month', purchase_ts) AS DATE) AS month_start,
    custuniq,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
  FROM recent_orders
  WHERE custuniq IN (SELECT custuniq FROM top3)
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT
  m.month_start,
  t.custuniq,
  COALESCE(a.order_count, 0) AS order_count
FROM months m
CROSS JOIN (SELECT custuniq FROM top3) t
LEFT JOIN agg a
  ON a.month_start = m.month_start
  AND a.custuniq = t.custuniq
ORDER BY t.custuniq, m.month_start;
